verdict.rationale: Temporal documents official SDKs that provide APIs for Workflow and Activity execution, automatic retries and resilience mechanisms. There are language-specific developer guides for Python and TypeScript, including a getting-started walkthrough, Worker Versioning, and AI integrations such as Google ADK and the Vercel AI SDK. A community user reports a library bug being fixed within a day after reporting it, which corroborates active SDK maintenance. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of all supported SDK languages, and independent hands-on evidence of SDK quality beyond a single anecdote.
